first_public_date_evidence: The Durand–Froment author-distributed full text explicitly states electronic publication on April 15, 2003 (journal article, DOI 10.1137/S1064827501397792).

title: Rooted-subtree rigidity and a sharp \(3/2\) gap for finite Haar variation projections
